description.value:
Earth Kunai. You compress nearby loose stone (or your own chakra-clay) into a kunai-shaped projectile. Make a spell attack roll against a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 piercing damage. On a critical hit, the earth-kunai shatters in the wound, adding 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Requires loose stone, sand, or earth within 5 feet of you (a paved floor counts). On a hard tile floor or in the air, you cannot cast.

Heightened (+2) Damage increases by 1d8.

system.requirements: loose earth or stone within 5 feet
